content.summary: Germany is Europe's largest economy with an exceptionally stable trade environment, strong legal protections, and high demand for quality goods. It serves as a major trade gateway into the European Union.
content.paymentPreference: Letter of Credit (L/C) or T/T with advance deposit for first-time orders
bestPractices: Strict EU CE marking and product safety compliance
EU Organic certification required for organic agricultural exports
Ensure German/English language labeling on commercial packaging
REACH compliance required for chemical and industrial products
content.leadTime: 24-32 days sea freight from Tanjung Priok (Jakarta) to Hamburg/Bremerhaven
